title: Digital Phenomena and Procedural Ethics

contributions.purpose: 给出"数字现象"的首个实证定义
contributions.mechanism: 对 114 份德国数字政策文档做系统内容分析,归纳六个独有特征
contributions.evaluation: 六特征覆盖率:技术可扩展性 100%、数据依赖 97%、算法中介 78% 等,编码信度 κ=0.82
contributions.source_quote: First, we provide the first systematic, empirically-grounded definition of what makes phenomena uniquely "digital," identifying six characteristics that distinguish digital from non-digital phenomena

contributions.purpose: 证明传统伦理框架对数字挑战不适用
contributions.mechanism: 系统编码识别传统道德概念无法覆盖的新伦理考量,按四类归类
contributions.evaluation: 识别 189 条新伦理考量(系统尺度效应 39%、前瞻伦理 25%、分布式能动 22%、数据尊严 14%)
contributions.source_quote: Second, we demonstrate that traditional ethical frameworks are inadequate for addressing digital challenges, with 189 novel ethical considerations identified

contributions.purpose: 为软件开发提供可操作的伦理治理框架
contributions.mechanism: 提出整合式程序伦理框架:四个新伦理概念(算法能动、数据尊严、计算正义、数字脆弱性)+五个开发流程组件
contributions.evaluation: 无实证评估,仅以语料实例计数支撑(如数据尊严 139 例、数字脆弱性 69 例);作者自承未在真实组织验证有效性
contributions.source_quote: Third, we propose an integrated procedural ethics framework that combines novel ethical concepts with systematic processes for software development

contributions.purpose: 论证伦理学自身需发生根本转变
contributions.mechanism: 从语料中归纳五个转变(个体→系统、反应→前瞻、人类中心→混合、局部→全局、同意→设计)
contributions.evaluation: 各转变有现象计数支撑(如 58 现象需系统性方法、28 现象需人机混合框架)
contributions.source_quote: Fourth, we provide evidence for fundamental shifts in ethics itself, requiring new approaches to responsibility, agency, and moral evaluation in digital contexts

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our empirical findings were systematically compared with Zuber's six theoretical characteristics of information technology uniqueness... This comparison enabled theoretical validation and extension of existing frameworks through empirical grounding.

Building upon our empirical findings and Zuber's theoretical insights, we propose an integrated procedural ethics framework that combines novel ethical concepts with systematic processes for software development.
Building on value-sensitive design approaches, this component provides systematic methods for identifying and specifying values at stake in software development projects

notes: 伦理/规范类论文但含实证成分(定性内容分析),四元组可套但 evaluation 是编码统计(κ、覆盖率)而非算法基准。整体框架建构强依赖 Zuber 2023 博士论文(六特征直接映射验证)。负结果/自承局限:语料仅德国政策文档,泛化性存疑;编码框架迭代开发可能有确认偏差;提出的程序伦理框架本身"have not empirically validated its effectiveness in real organizational contexts"。C3 的 evaluation 实为空缺,属协议半适配。
